title: Contrix Anchor
description: Wire shape of a Contrix Anchor. Identity & signature model (see zh/authz/event-auth-state-resolution.md §4): the typed `id` (`cx:anchor:<algo>:<hex>`) is content-derived — its hex equals H(anchor_canonical_bytes) under the Realm hash_profile. Anchor canonical bytes are the canonical JSON of the body fields ONLY (realm_id, predecessor_refs, frontier, state_root, optional previous_state_root / previous_hash_profile, anchored_at, hlc plus any other signed top-level field). The `id` is NOT part of canonical bytes (it is the hash OUTPUT, not input — no self-reference). The `anchorer_sig` is NOT part of canonical bytes (it covers the bytes; signatures never sign themselves). Receivers MUST (a) recompute H(anchor_canonical_bytes) and verify it equals the hex in `id` (`digest_mismatch` otherwise) and (b) verify `anchorer_sig` over the same canonical bytes (`invalid_signature` otherwise). additionalProperties=false prevents undeclared fields from sneaking into the transcript.

id.description: Content-derived typed reference. hex part MUST equal H(anchor_canonical_bytes) under the Realm hash_profile, where anchor_canonical_bytes is the canonical JSON of every signed body field EXCEPT `id` and `anchorer_sig`. Receivers MUST recompute and verify; mismatch → digest_mismatch. NEVER include `id` in the hash input — that would create a self-reference.

frontier.description: Set of event_digest values covered by this Anchor. Each item is the content-addressed hash of a reducer-input Event's canonical bytes (excluding proofs and unsigned), encoded as `<algo>:<hex>` and equal to that Event's proof.event_digest. See event-auth-state-resolution.md §3.

previous_state_root.description: Hash-algorithm transition only: present iff this Anchor is a Transition Anchor under cx.profile.hash_transition.v1. When present, MUST be computed with the previous hash_profile algorithm over the same frontier as state_root, and MUST equal the receiver-recomputed root under that algorithm before the new state_root is accepted. See event-auth-state-resolution.md §4.2.5.

previous_hash_profile.description: Profile id of the previous hash algorithm. Required iff previous_state_root is present; absent on non-transition Anchors.

anchorer_sig.description: Signature over anchor_canonical_bytes (every signed body field EXCEPT `id` and `anchorer_sig`). MUST NOT enter the canonical bytes itself — signatures never sign themselves. Anchor is not an Event Envelope, so its signature uses the generic non-Event proof field `payload_hash`; that value MUST equal H(anchor_canonical_bytes) under the Realm hash_profile. Event Envelope proofs use `event_digest` instead.

anchored_at.description: Wall-clock timestamp at which the anchorer signed this Anchor. Used only for reducer-derived projection timestamps and freshness diagnostics; not a lattice winner input.

verification_method.description: DID or DID URL of the signing key. Bare DID is accepted (resolves to the controller's current key); DID URLs with key fragment are RECOMMENDED. The previous regex pattern `(#.+)?$` was redundant under greedy `[^\s]+` and has been normalized to the canonical DID pattern; semantics are unchanged.

payload_hash.description: Hash of anchor_canonical_bytes for this non-Event Anchor signature. Do not rename to event_digest: event_digest is reserved for Event Envelope proofs.
